issue.title: SASE phase finalization failure after close discards the phase's tracked edits; relaunch had to recover from a partial stash

task_type_fields.impact: When finalization fails after a phase agent closes its bead, the agent's completed tracked edits are silently discarded. The closed bead then claims work that is not on master, and recovery took three extra agent runs (about 1 h 10 m). Two fixes are likely needed in the SASE runner (sase project), not in bob-cli: order finalization so a bead is not left closed without a landed commit, and preserve the full dirty tree (tracked and untracked) before any reset.
task_type_fields.location: SASE runner phase finalization / relaunch reset (sase project); observed on bob-cli workspace for bead bob-cli-ct.3
task_type_fields.repro:
Proposed by phase bead bob-cli-ct.3 (note #6) and recorded by epic bob-cli-ct's land agent.

What happened on athena, 2026-10-26 (all times EDT):

1. Agent bob-cli-ct.3--7 finished phase bob-cli-ct.3: it implemented `bob ref recatalog` and its wiring, ran the athena backfill (three vault commits), passed `just check` and `just docs-check`, and closed the bead at 20:28.
2. Its continuation artifact `file:explicit:86b647eb0231399b6d91fda6` ended `failed`. No implementation commit landed: origin/master stayed at 115a3610, which has no `ref recatalog`.
3. The reflog shows master resets at 20:33. Stash 3454bb0eb6bd35f0bc4f68c0e0cf8cfb190c6dac (20:34) kept only the three previously untracked files (pdf_links.rs, recatalog.rs, tests/cli/ref_library/recatalog.rs). Every tracked integration edit was lost: CLI dispatch, help, completion, catalog, doctor, attach, and docs.
4. Relaunch bob-cli-ct.3 (launched against the closed bead) and two further continuations (--1, --2) had to recover the stash, recreate the lost wiring, and re-verify. The work finally landed as 42abfa70 at 21:36.

To reproduce, read the bob-cli-ct.3 notes (#3 to #10) and the artifacts linked to that bead (`file:explicit:68a06d5d2a81c40e1cc9c3e1` is the recovered pre-verification patch).

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by bob-cli-ct.3 note #6: a closed, verified phase lost its implementation edits when its finalization failed, so the closed bead claimed work not on master.
